headline: All 10 graduating trainees at Hong Leong Bank take permanent roles
body: All 10 trainees in the graduating cohort have taken permanent roles at HLB. During the 12-month programme's four rotations, trainees deployed AI chatbots powered by Google’s Agent Development Kit (ADK) and UiPath robotic process automation (RPA) tools.
note: Building the tools in-house keeps the platforms under the bank's own ownership, which fits its “Digital At The Core” strategy.

evidence.text: Hong Leong Bank (HLB) is strengthening its in-house technology capabilities through talent development, AI adoption and cloud modernisation.
The bank has followed its “Digital At The Core” strategy for more than a decade, focusing on building internal engineering expertise and maintaining ownership of its technology platforms.
The 12-month programme consists of four rotations designed to develop technical expertise and operational skills.
All 10 trainees in the graduating cohort have taken permanent roles at HLB.
During their rotations, trainees deployed AI chatbots powered by Google’s Agent Development Kit (ADK) and UiPath robotic process automation (RPA) tools.
